title: Cheap materials, badly made, looks cheap and tacky, difficult to put together
text:
Cheap materials, badly made, looks cheap and tacky, difficult to put together. This headboard arrived in a massive box with loads of padding and was very heavy. So we had high that it was indeed a luxurious piece of furniture made from "high quality" materials. Opening it and laying all the pieces out to put together was were our hopes were dashed and the cursing began. this is a two man job without question. And you need a mallet.

The main part of the headboard is in two large sections that attach in the center via a single dowel and then are braced on the top and bottom using six screws and two brace boards. Joining the two pieces together with the dowel requires two people and so much force, pushing and hammering with a soft mallet that we were sweating. Fine. It's in and done and there is a damage to one side now from the mallet where the cheap veneer dented and pealed back. See the photo. The bottom brace aligned and fit perfectly with almost no visible seam. The top brace...has a huge gap on both sides if you want the pre-drilled holes to line up. See the photo.

Pulling the padding and slip cover down over the assembled unit was amateur hour - the sides aren't smooth and the padding snagged and tore as it went down. It's not visible once you get the suede like slipcover in place, but none of it lies smoothly due to the bunching and snagging of the padding. This could be prevented entirely by making the padding case another quarter inch wider on both sides. Attaching this thing to the bed frame was another aggravation since the pre-drilled holes didn't match up to the standard queen size bed rails on the bed frame we already own. We had to rig it up and at this price point, that's beyond ridiculous.

Bottom line... Three star deduction for poor quality materials. Poor quality control on measurements at the point of construction. Further more the difficulty of assembling this headboard is overly complicated and poorly thought out. Honestly, this headboard could and should be shipped to customers completely assembled and ready to use - the size of the box it comes in would not need to change and the weight certainly would not change by pre-assembling the entire thing at the factory. At this price point I expected that! And most importantly, the final product looks cheap and tacky. It's fine for a little used guest bed, but by no means is this good enough for your master suite. See the photo. It's lumpy, uneven and the sand color is bland and looks like you grabbed a piece of random fabric at the hobby store. If this were priced in the under hundred dollar range it would be a 3 1/2 star rating, as it is...a two star is the best I feel it deserves.

features: The Slipcovered Headboard is constructed with a sturdy wood frame that is padded for maximum comfort, making it solid yet cozy.
But what makes it truly unique is the removable tailored slipcover- so you can change colors on a whim, with the seasons, or simply because it is time for a wash!
Because it is slipcovered, we were able to construct this piece so that it comes apart and is easy to move from house to house so it's perfect for renters or college students!
The slipcover's fabric has a lush velvety hand in a rich natural sand color.
Fits most standard bed frames (metal bed frame NOT included)
